text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I... lost... Huff... sniffle...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Nishino Flower's so fast!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
She shows great promise for her classic
year.
Good luck, Flower!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Wow...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When I head out to meet up with
Nishino Flower
after the race, she looks
utterly exhausted!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes... That was just... a lot...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry... that I didn't win...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's proven today that she can handle
G1 races. She may not have won, but I
believe she'll
perform excellently in her
classic year.
choice_data_list: That was a good run—we can expect ...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Does that mean...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: You have faith in my running?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ehehe!
choice_data_list: Of course! You'll definitely win n...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you...
That's a great relief to hear.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's her trainer? Now there's
someone with
a sharp eye for runners!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: They were praising Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(I'm glad I worked so hard. It wasn't
easy, but
Trainer looked so happy.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(And thanks to Trainer's guidance and
care, I
don't feel as tired as I did after
my debut race.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(I was wondering why I became
race-ready so
early...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (But maybe it's because it's happening now that...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: All right! I've made up my mind!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I've decided what I want my
next race to
be.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I want to come back here again, when
the cherry
blossoms are in bloom!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yup. I want to run in the Oka Sho and
take on the
Triple Tiara!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Triple Tiara tour comprises three G1
races that can only be run in one's
classic year—the
Oka Sho, the Japanese
Oaks, and the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you! I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we decide to take on the Triple
Tiara by running in its first race—the Oka
Sho! However,
there's something I want
to know.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Many Umamusume who run in the Hanshin
Juvenile Fillies go on to run in
the Triple Tiara
tour. It's only natural to
want to challenge higher-level races.
choice_data_list: Did you have that in mind from the...
Did you have that in mind from the...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thinking back, deciding to run the Hanshin
Juvenile Fillies was a bold
choice for her. Maybe I'm only thinking
about this because she's never voiced
what her dream is, but...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um... Well...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...I'll tell you after the Oka Sho!
